items.text: San Francisco: GM John Lynch says WR Mike Evans (Achilles) and WR Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) are unlikely to play Sunday (both sat last week too). Also DNP - RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring), LT Trent Williams, S Siran Neal; limited - DE Nick Bosa (knee/calf), WR Christian Kirk, CB Upton Stout, CB Nate Hobbs, WR Demarcus Robinson. WR Ricky Pearsall out for season.
Las Vegas: CB Darien Porter (groin) DNP; limited - DT Thomas Booker, DT Foley Fatukasi, TE Ian Thomas. Kirk Cousins starts.
